profile.headline: Databases @ Google
profile.summary:
- Databases and data management.
- Distributed systems and parallel computing.
- Concurrency and synchronization mechanisms.
- Multicore and multithreaded systems performance.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Core Query processing: query optimization & indexing + search
- Spanner Serving stack: transaction routing & location metadata

positions.title: Graduate Student Researcher
positions.description: Researched non-blocking interthread communication schemes for parallel algorithms on multicore systems.

positions.title: PhD Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Improved a test-coverage metrics visualization pipeline for Google’s Fuchsia OS. Reducing dashboard rendering time up to 40x via query optimization and vectorization.

positions.title: PhD Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Researched and developed a C++-based Transaction Log for a highly concurrent in-memory B-Tree-based Key-Value Store, reducing transaction commit latency by exploiting non-volatile memory technologies.

positions.title: PhD Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed C++-based database relational operators in Google’s core SQL engine, F1 Query. Reducing query execution latency up to 7x by exploiting vector execution and “interesting orderings” for the query planner.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Maintained Oracle’s internal business solutions systems, including development, production support, monitoring, reporting and coordination between multiple product development and IT support groups.
